author: fwyzard
body:
MIGraphX's TensorFlow parser compiles its own copy of the TensorFlow protobuf messages, in the "tensorflow" package, and links them against the shared protobuf library. Loading it together with CMSSW's TensorFlow registers the same messages twice in the global descriptor pool, and protobuf aborts the process.

See ROCm/AMDMIGraphX#5089 and ROCm/AMDMIGraphX#5332 for more information, and ROCm/AMDMIGraphX#5333 for the upstream fix.
title: MIGraphX: give the TF protobuf messages and files unique names
